name: Scholastica
original_name: 書架のスコラスティカ
source:
A member of the Punishment Squad. She is Benedictus' younger sister and also considered a mage of Index.
Scholastica was resurrected as half of Acedia by Misao, in the same body as Benedictus, remembering nothing but his mission to protect the seal.

[Edited from the [url=http://11eyes.wikia.com/wiki/Main_Page]11eyes wiki[/url].]
